text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while conducting team training on 
the track—

text_block_list.name: Dog
text_block_list.text: Woof!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Whoa-aaagh!? A d-d-d-dog...!? Why the heck 
is there a dog here!?
choice_data_list: That dog looks kind of familiar...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? Come to think of it... Looking 
closely at that guy... is that Pochi?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Pochi is a neighborhood pet dog we often 
see out for walks when doing perimeter 
training with the team.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Maybe it escaped and came over to play. 
Anyway, while we contact the owner—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Should I hold onto her so she doesn't 
wander off?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, but if we chase after Pochi too 
aggressively, won't we just scare him?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
That said, what're we gonna do? We can't 
just leave it alone, right?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Huuuhm, in times like this...—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Let's capture them ever so gently with 
everyone's love ♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Looook, it's your wittle fwiend~~♡ Woof 
woof woof♡

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Come on! Get over here, woof! Bring it on, 
woof!

text_block_list.name: Pochi
text_block_list.text: Woof! Bow-wow♪

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Come on, over this way too~♪ Our 
engagement's going through the roof, 
woof~~~~♪

text_block_list.name: Pochi
text_block_list.text: Woof! Bow-wow! Bow-wow! Awoo... Woof.
choice_data_list:
Alright, Pochi's getting tired! Now's our 
chance!!

Alright, Pochi's getting tired! Now's the 
time!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Gotcha! Caught ya!!

text_block_list.name: Pochi
text_block_list.text: Kyuu~n...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, 'Operation: Distract Pochi Together 
and Catch Him Once He's Tired Out from 
Playing' ...was a huge success♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for everyone's 
cooperationâ¡

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Man, making me go through all that 
hassle... Aaargh, what a pointless waste 
of energy.
choice_data_list:
For all your complaining, you still gave 
it your all to help, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Right? Even when she caught them shouting 
"Take this!", it was actually super gentle 
and full of "love"♪

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: I-I was just swept along! By you guys!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
So much time has passed since the team was 
formed. Though mismatched, everyone's 
hearts are slowly being bound together by 
"Love"— or so it seems. Probably.

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"For now, we should probably take care of 
it, right? Come on, over here, over 
here~☆"

text_block_list.name: Pochi
text_block_list.text: Whine...? *Sniff, sniff*...

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"There, there, good girl, good girl~☆ 
...Just keep coming this way—"

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: Hya... rawr?!

text_block_list.name: Pochi
text_block_list.text: Waf, waf-waf...!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: Ah, Puppet Maru-chan was taken away!

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: Ah... w-waah...! Awawawawa............!
choice_data_list: Calm down, let's all catch Pochi together!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Flank around, dammiiiit!!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Right on! Just like that, everyone corner 
them against the wall—!

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: Ngh...!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: Alrighty, secured and confiscated~~~

text_block_list.name: Pochi
text_block_list.text: Kyu~n...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Here. It's important to you, right? 
Don't let anyone take it again.

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
""Phew~~, that really surprised me~~!! 
Espo-san! Everyone! Thank you sooooo 
much~☆""

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...! D-Don't scare me like that, damn 
it...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though it happened in an unexpected way, 
it seemed companions could truly 
understand one another without 
words—maybe. It was an event that made one 
believe in such possibilities.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
A frail, lost lamb... As a saint, I must 
take her into my care at once—!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Haaah!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With several Umamusume on the job, 
catching up to a single dog was easy 
enough, but—

text_block_list.name: Pochi
text_block_list.text: Kyuu~n...

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear... It's tucked right into the gap 
between the walls...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Please, leave it to me. With my sacred 
prayers, I will open Pochi's heart...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, blessings upon this fluffy life— Come 
hither, Pochi-san—come unto me—...!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Like someone who was chasing me with the 
face of a demon just a second ago is gonna 
show up praying...

text_block_list.name: Pochi
text_block_list.text: ...Whimper...?

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: Ah, some of it's starting to show.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Now, everyone together... Let us purify 
our hearts...

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: Come forth, Pochi—hither come—...

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: Come on, you too, Espo-san!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Huh... Ugh... Ahhhhh, dammit!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: C-Come forth, Pochi—come to this place—...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, as a result of everyone continuing 
to bestow holy blessings upon Pochi—

text_block_list.name: Pochi
text_block_list.text: Kyu~n, whimper...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Are you serious...? Wait, really?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And thus, thanks to the united prayers of 
the entire team— though whether that was 
the actual reason is debatable— Pochi was 
safely rescued.
